name: anything-llm
description: The best solution for turning private documents into a chat bot using off-the-shelf tools and commercially viable AI technologies.
author: Timothy Carambat (Mintplex Labs)

scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm setup:envs && pnpm prisma:setup && echo "Setup complete! Run pnpm dev:all to start development."
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n server,frontend,collector -c blue,green,yellow "pnpm dev:server" "pnpm dev:frontend" "pnpm dev:collector"
scripts.prisma:migrate: pnpm --filter anything-llm-server exec prisma migrate dev --name init
scripts.prisma:seed: pnpm --filter anything-llm-server exec prisma db seed
scripts.prisma:setup: pnpm prisma:generate && pnpm prisma:migrate && pnpm prisma:seed
scripts.normalize:translations: cd frontend/src/locales && node normalizeEn.mjs && cd ../../.. && pnpm lint && pnpm verify:translations
